catalog.method: GET fixed URL; body is an RSA-signed S1. AES-GCM envelope -> JSON; every XXTEA-encrypted field is then decrypted (servers, networks, top-level)
catalog.notes: All 9 live servers are premium (none free). The result JSON drops update_api, auth_api and notice_api (download APIs). Password-protected .pulse files use the TOURUX1P: format (password via the engine's credentials input).

dependencies: Python >=3.10; standard library only (cryptography optional, for the RSA-SHA256 signature check)

files.method: S1. signed AES-GCM envelope (same as the catalog) or TOURUX1P: password-protected variant
